title: An individual collector control may target an experimental collector explicitly, bypassing the bulk-run exclusion
requirement: Where a per-collector (as opposed to bulk) run control exists, it SHOULD be able to target an experimental/non-production collector explicitly, even though such a collector is excluded from the bulk 'run all' (STD-UI-COM-006).
rationale: This is a genuinely split pattern across the fleet, not a settled one — flagged deliberately as SHOULD/QUALIFIED rather than MUST. Watch-clank, korean-tech-wire, tablet-clank, and feature-phone-clank all let an operator run an experimental collector individually from the GUI. smartwatch-clank explicitly does the opposite: experimental sources have no run control at all in the GUI and can only be promoted via an out-of-band config edit before they become runnable. oem-radar splits the difference again: 'heavy' collectors are individually runnable, but genuinely-EXPERIMENTAL collectors are not wired into the GUI catalog at all, only reachable via separate CLI/soak scripts. Both postures have a real rationale (operator convenience for ad-hoc testing vs. a stricter promotion-gates-everything posture) — this needs an explicit operator judgment call, not a default toward the majority.
acceptance: If adopted as MUST later: an individual run control exists and is reachable for experimental collectors
If rejected in favor of smartwatch-clank's posture: individual run controls for experimental collectors must be absent, and the GUI must clearly state how to promote one

evidence.summary: Four Clanks allow individually targeting an experimental collector from the GUI.
Explicit counter-pattern: experimental sources are never selectable in the GUI at all; promotion via config is the only path to making one runnable.
Genuinely-experimental collectors are not wired into the GUI catalog at all; only reachable via separate standalone CLI soak scripts against an isolated database.

notes: Pass 1 candidate, deliberately unresolved. Recommendation in docs/gui-ratification-pass-1.md is QUALIFIED — needs an explicit operator decision between the two postures before this can move to REVIEWED, not just more evidence-gathering.
